title: No tick schedules the D31 revisit: admission-boundary decisions D26/D27/D28 are bounded by an integration host nobody has wired or planned
body: The parity record (sz0) records the Workflow host's admission divergences — no wave barrier, no role-job alone-ness, no blocker read on the claim — as deliberate precisely because integration is an unwired boundary (D31), and each of those decisions says to revisit when an IntegrationHost lands. But no open tick wires the merge-and-gate half (the remaining Phase 5 ticks are t5p, us2, v3q, u9h, s8p, hb8), so the revisit condition can arrive silently through a test-only seam (env.TICFAC_INTEGRATION) and the divergences would keep passing gates while no longer being safe. A tick should own wiring the real IntegrationHost — or explicitly deciding the Workflow host will not perform integration this phase — and with it the D26/D27/D28 revisit.
